name: Ninja of the Five Elements
body:
Ninjas of the Five elements choose a path of healing over harm. The philosophy of the five elements teaches how the nature of magic, the healing arts, and the five elements work in tandem to create balance.

By mastering this balance, ninjas of the five elements strive to attain perfection of mind and body. A ninja of the five elements turns away from the study of poisons and sneak attacks to instead learn how to channel positive and elemental energy to heal a body’s imbalances.

Alignment

A ninja of the five elements cannot have an evil alignment.

This alters alignment.

Class Skills

A ninja of the five elements gains Heal, Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (religion), and Survival as class skills. A ninja of the five elements does not get Disguise, Intimidate, Knowledge (nobility), Perform, or Sleight of Hand as class skills.

This alters class skills.

Elemental Mystery

A ninja of the five elements chooses one of the following oracle mysteries: Elemental, Flame, Metal, Stone, Waves, or Wood. At 1st level, ninjas of the five elements can cast the first spell listed as a spell-like ability once per day. At 4th level, they gain the next spell listed, castable once per day as a spell-like ability. Every two levels thereafter, ninjas of the five elements gain the next spell on the list, which they can also cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

Furthermore, at 4th and 8th level, a ninja of the five elements selects one revelation from their chosen mystery. The ninja treats their ninja of the five elements level as their oracle level for this revelation.

For the purpose of qualifying for feats, this ability counts as both the mystery and the revelation class features.

This replaces poison use, uncanny dodge, and improved uncanny dodge.

Elemental Healing (Su)

At 1st level, a ninja of the five elements can draw energy from the elemental building blocks of the planet to heal themselves and allies. To initiate an elemental healing, a ninja of the five elements must use a standard action and select a number of targets (this can include themselves) equal to their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), all of whom must be within 30 feet of the ninja.

The elemental healing cures 1d6 points of damage plus 1d6 points of damage for every two ninja of the five elements levels beyond 1st. A ninja of the five elements can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

This replaces all iterations of sneak attack.

Elemental Wisdom

Ninjas of the five elements use their Wisdom score (not Charisma) to determine the number of points in their ki pool. They also substitute Wisdom for Charisma when a ninja trick, rogue talent, or revelation refers to Charisma or Intelligence.

This alters ki pool.

Medicinal Touch (Ex)

At 2nd level, a ninja of the five elements can never select a ninja trick that interacts with sneak attack or poison. Instead, the ninja adds the following options to their list of ninja tricks to choose from: Restore Balance: A ninja of the five elements with this trick can expend 1 ki point and touch a creature as a standard action. The touched creature is cured of the fatigued, sickened, nauseated, blinded, deafened, and staggered conditions or has two points of ability damage restored (as lesser restoration). A ninja of the five elements can restore balance on themself as an immediate action as soon as they acquire the condition, essentially negating the condition before it can take effect.

Enlightened Steps (Ex)

At 3rd level, a ninja of the five elements gains the light steps class feature earlier than a standard ninja.

At 6th level, the ninja’s use of this ability expands. First, a ninja of the five elements can now use light steps either as a full-round action or as a move action. If the ninja of the five elements uses it as a move action, they can move up to their current land speed (which may be enhanced by spending a ki point). Second, a ninja of the five elements can now defy gravity, traversing any surface, including walls, trees, and ceilings (as long as they end their movement on a surface that can support them). During their movement, the ninja of the five elements can change surfaces freely from floor to ceiling to wall, etc.

This replaces no trace and alters light steps, but counts as light steps for the purposes of qualifying for feats and ninja tricks.

Ki Master (Su)

At 20th level, a ninja of the five elements gains a bonus revelation from their elemental mystery. Additionally, once per day, a ninja of the five elements can expend 1 ki point when using elemental healing to automatically heal the maximum amount possible without the need to roll. Finally, when expending a ki point to gain an extra attack at their highest base attack bonus, a ninja of the five elements gains two extra attacks instead of one.

This replaces hidden master.
